exclusions.name: alternative transport (e.g., private boat, helicopter)
exclusions.why_safe: Evidence e9 states the ferry is the only carrier with validated refrigerated storage and Penhallow's cold-chain policy permits handoff only to such carriers, so no alternative transport can be used.

exclusions.name: other vaccine suppliers or stockpiles
exclusions.why_safe: Evidence e2 confirms no other facility on the island stocks the pediatric vaccines, and the only order is with Penhallow.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the ferry will operate on Friday 14 August (the next scheduled sailing day) is unknown because the gale warning ends at 3:00 AM Thursday, but the ferry's decision to resume service after a cancellation is not stated.
If the ferry does not sail before the deadline, the vaccine cannot arrive at the island dock in time.

Even if the vaccine arrives at the island dock, the courier must meet the sailing and deliver to the clinic before 9:00 AM; the timing of the sailing arrival and courier availability are not specified.
